title: Harvest readiness
summary: Helps the user know when and how to harvest each crop: ripeness checklists, technique, photo verdicts, timely notices and one-tap harvest logging.

acceptance: A photo of a planting returns one of: not yet (with days to go), ready soon, ready now, past its best
Each verdict shows a confidence level
Planting date and variety maturity are used as context
Crops that can't be judged by photo redirect to the signs checklist
Photos taken offline are queued and analysed when online
